title: FilteredComplexPositivePages
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K^\bullet$ a cochain complex and $F$ a decreasing filtration of $K^\bullet$ by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. There exists a cohomological spectral sequence $E$ [def-sp-spectral-sequence] starting at page $1$, with differentials of bidegree $(r,1-r)$, such that for all integers $p,q,r$ with $r\ge1$, the subobjects $B_r^{p,q}=F.\mathrm{complexBoundaries}(p,p+q,r)$ and $Z_r^{p,q}=F.\mathrm{complexCycles}(p,p+q,r)$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] satisfy $B_r^{p,q}\le Z_r^{p,q}$ and $E_r^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{coker}(B_r^{p,q}\hookrightarrow Z_r^{p,q})$. No finite-filtration hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: In the abelian category of bigraded objects, put $A^{p,q}=F^{p+1}K^{p+1+q}$ and use the differential of $K$ on each component. The filtration inclusions give a monomorphism $\alpha:A\to A[-1,1]$ commuting with the differential. Componentwise short exact sequences and their homology sequences give the shifted exact couple of remark-differential-object-selfmap. This construction uses only finite kernels and cokernels in each component, not a countable coproduct in $\mathcal C$.

Derive the exact couple repeatedly [def-sp-exact-couple], beginning with $E_1$, the homology of its graded cokernel. In the fixed-couple coordinates $(P,Q)=(2p+q,-p)$, its initial differential has degree $(2,-1)$, which becomes $(1,0)$ in $(p,q)$. After $s$ derivations it has degree $(s+2,-s-1)$, which becomes $(s+1,-s)$. With $r=s+1$ the degree is $(r,1-r)$. Derived-couple homology supplies the isomorphisms $H(E_r)^{p,q}\cong E_{r+1}^{p,q}$.

The self-map calculation in remark-differential-object-selfmap identifies the cycles as the projected inverse image under $d$ of the $r$-fold inclusion, and the boundaries as the projected inverse image of $dA$ under the $(r-1)$-fold inclusion. In component $(p,q)$ these are $F^pK^{p+q}\cap d^{-1}(F^{p+r}K^{p+q+1})$ and $F^pK^{p+q}\cap d(F^{p-r+1}K^{p+q-1})$, each with $F^{p+1}K^{p+q}$ added before quotienting. These are exactly the defined subobjects $Z_r$ and $B_r$. Since $d^2=0$, the unprojected boundaries lie in the cycles; addition, pullback and image preserve this containment. The exact-couple page calculation is their cokernel quotient.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_positive_spectralSequence
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence C 1,
      ∀ (p q r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
        ∃ hBZ : F.complexBoundaries p (p + q) r ≤ F.complexCycles p (p + q) r,
          Nonempty ((E.page r).X (p, q) ≅ cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hBZ))
